pages.text: Mila enters a busy open market with colorful stands and cheerful voices.
Farmers display tomatoes, bananas, greens, and beans from nearby fields.
At another stand, crafters sell baskets, cloth, and painted toys.
Mila watches a shopper compare prices before choosing apples.
A seller places fruit on a scale to measure the weight.
Bakers offer warm bread while fishers bring the morning catch.
People carry reusable bags and plan what they need.
Mila says Please and Thank you at each stop.
She learns markets are not only for shopping but also for meeting neighbors.
Back home she says: markets show teamwork between growers, makers, and families.
